principle: Reuse protocol concepts only when they can be mapped to verified PM5 capabilities; never claim libfreefare support merely because the protocol family overlaps.

reference.role: protocol and API reference, not a direct source-code dependency

licensing_rule: Do not copy libfreefare source into this repository until its applicable license and dependency obligations are reviewed for the exact files being reused.
truth_rule: A capability is DETECTED only after the PM5 reports or successfully completes the corresponding verified operation. Protocol-family similarity remains EXPECTED until tested.
